name: park-and-see-monorepo
description: Park & See - Mode développement avec backend unique + frontend HMR

scripts.dev:win: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend:once:ps" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:sh: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend:once:sh" "npm run frontend"
scripts.stop:backend: powershell -Command "$proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($proc) { Stop-Process -Id $proc -Force; Write-Host 'Backend stopped' } else { Write-Host 'Backend not running' }"
scripts.clean: cd frontend-react && rmdir /s /q node_modules build 2>nul & cd .. & cd backend && mvn clean & cd ..
